title: Clay Roof Section — 2m Repeat
description: S03 modular clay gable-roof section with three restrained staggered courses per slope. Four-metre wall-centre span, two-metre Y repeat, explicit wall-cap mounting plane at local Z=0. Real opposite-face rafter/deck and ridge contacts with no forced interpenetration. Actual wall-cap and repeat-end contacts are recorded in local assembly evidence. Mounting origin is at wall-cap level; no terrain placement, structural load-capacity or runtime collision guarantee. Pending independent review.
